meta.purpose: The quick-decisions inbox (DESIGN.md §2.3). Each item carries the recommended answer pre-filled; the owner scans, ticks Accept, and corrects at most one.
meta.source: PLAN.md — Business decisions needed from the owner

decisions.question: Daily nudge time and timezone
decisions.recommended: 08:00 Europe/Stockholm (= 06:00 UTC in summer, 07:00 UTC in winter)
decisions.why: Blocks the Routine. Everything else has a safe default; this one decides when the coach speaks.

decisions.question: Which of the three Hostinger accounts hosts which DB-blocked repo
decisions.needed_for: PR-2 batching — which repos share one hPanel sitting
decisions.recommended: Batch by market (SE vs PY) as a proxy until you say otherwise
decisions.why: Batching is only worth it if the repos really sit in the same panel. The proxy currently puts besikt alone in a 25-minute sitting; the truth probably merges it with something.

decisions.question: Confirm the proposed tiers in data/portfolio.json
decisions.needed_for: PR-1 scoring — the biggest single ranking lever
decisions.recommended: Keep as seeded: vendercrm, facturar, qr, propia.node, contabilidad = infra; everything else revenue or experiment
decisions.why: Tier is set once and rarely touched. Getting it wrong quietly mis-ranks the queue for months.

decisions.question: May the coach propose archiving repos, and does "kill" mean GitHub-archive or just a flag?
decisions.recommended: Propose yes; execution always needs your explicit tick; "kill" sets a flag only, nothing is archived on GitHub
decisions.why: Decides how much authority the monthly scope review has.

decisions.question: Weekly deep-audit depth
decisions.recommended: GitHub-API-only weekly, with a monthly clone-and-read pass
decisions.why: API-only is cheap and the % estimates drift slowly; the monthly deep pass catches what the API cannot see.

decisions.question: Classify the owner-setup-unclassified blockers — one line each: what exactly is the next owner step?
decisions.recommended: Answer the batch below — these repos rank on % alone until they are classified
decisions.why: 15 repos, several at 85–95%, are currently ranked with a pessimistic 25-minute guess. One line each turns them into bookable sessions.
